title: Baby Leo and Friends Learn About Colors
summary: Today, Baby Leo and friends go on a colorful adventure! With Bella's clever plan, they learn about different colors using fun objects around them. Together, they discover how colors can brighten their day!
lesson: Kids learn about colors through fun activities.
beats: 1. Baby Leo, Bella, Bobo, Marjona, and Twinkle are playing outside. They notice the beautiful rainbow in the sky from the last rain.
2. Bella has a brilliant idea! She suggests they find colorful objects to learn about colors together.
3. Baby Leo gets excited and asks, 'Why are colors important?' Bella explains that colors make the world fun and beautiful.
4. Marjona sings a happy song about colors, making everyone dance as they start their adventure.
5. Bobo finds a red ball. He says, 'This ball is red!' Everyone cheers and learns together.
6. Twinkle uses her magic to make the grass glow green, showing how vibrant colors can be.
7. They gather many colorful objects: a blue flower, a yellow sun, and a purple butterfly.
8. As they play, they make a fun game to match objects with their colors.
9. They laugh and cheer when they successfully match everything. Baby Leo shouts, 'Hooray for colors!'
10. They finish their adventure by painting a big rainbow together, celebrating the beauty of colors.
